opening.argument: The video promotes Diamond cloud mining as a profitable opportunity, claiming 25% annual interest without a power requirement and directing viewers to the listed website. The speaker describes sending Bitcoin to the platform, where it is converted into cloud shares, and reports approximately 10% ROI in four days. The presentation also shows a Diamond account page with a “Pay with Bitcoins” control and mining-related fields. Although the speaker denies that it is a scam and favorably distinguishes it from BitConnect, those statements do not verify the platform’s returns, payout history, or completion of any payment. The arrangement is therefore presented through substantial earnings claims and a path for Bitcoin-funded participation, while its actual performance remains unverified.
